app.name: Spag AI Studio
app.tagline: AI voice agents for Nigerian businesses

nav.resize: Drag to resize the side panel (double-click to reset)

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: We will email you a one-time sign-in link. No password needed.
login.sent: Check your email. If the address is valid, a sign-in link is on its way. It expires in 15 minutes.
login.devHint: Running locally? Open the fake inbox at http://localhost:8025, or look for the link in the terminal where the app is running.
login.devShortcut: Development shortcut: open your sign-in link directly. This button never appears on the live site.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.noOrganisation: Your account is not part of any organisation. Ask an admin to invite you.

verify.title: Finish signing in
verify.body: Click the button to finish signing in to Spag AI Studio.
verify.invalid: This sign-in link is not valid.
verify.used: This sign-in link has already been used.

dashboard.title: Welcome
dashboard.intro: Build an AI voice agent, test it, then run a call campaign.
dashboard.step1: Create an agent from a preset
dashboard.step2: Fill in your business details and check the lint score
dashboard.step4: Upload leads and start a campaign

agents.title: Agents
agents.empty: No agents yet. Create one from scratch or from a template.
agents.choosePresetIntro: Each preset is a ready-made agent you can edit. Guardrails are always included.
agents.deleteConfirm: Delete this agent? This cannot be undone.
agents.readOnly: You have view-only access. Ask an admin to change your role to edit agents.

builder.testUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. The Lab uses the last saved version. Continue?

business.intro: These details are filled into the prompt. Fields marked * are required.

blocks.intro: Your prompt follows the five-part framework. Edit, reorder, switch off or add blocks. Locked guardrails can be reworded but not removed.
blocks.lockedHelp: Always included. You can reword it, but not remove it.
blocks.title: Block title

parts.solution: Phase 2: Solution and what makes us different

firstMessage.intro: The first thing the agent says when the call connects. Ask only one question.

tools.intro: Actions the agent can take during a call. In this prototype, tools are simulated.

silence.intro: What happens when the caller goes quiet.
silence.endAfter: End the call after (seconds of silence)

voice.intro: Pick the voice for this agent. Press Play to hear it. Only mock voices work for now.
voice.playHint: Play reads this agent's first message, filled in for a sample customer.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.latencyOk: Length is fine for a voice call.
preview.latencyWarn: Getting long: replies may feel slow.
preview.latencyBad: Too long: replies will be slow.

variables.intro: Variables are written as {{name}} in blocks and the first message.
variables.name: Name
variables.label: Label

voices.title: Voices
voices.intro: Listen to each voice before you choose one for an agent.
voices.mockNote: Mock voices are played by your browser's built-in speech. They show the wording and timing, not the final voice quality. Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo lines may be read with an English accent until a real voice provider is connected.
voices.tryIntro: Type a line and press Play on any voice. Leave it empty to hear each voice's sample.
voices.tryPlaceholder: e.g. Good morning, Sir. This is a reminder that your payment of ₦25,000 is due on 15/10/2026.
voices.unused: Not used by any agent yet.

simulator.title: Lab
simulator.intro: Have a pretend call with any of your agents. Nobody is called and nothing is charged.
simulator.mockNote: Replies come from the free mock agent. It handles common answers (yes, no, busy, stop calling, are you a robot, a day and time, an email) but does not read your prompt. Connect a language model in the settings file to test the real prompt.
simulator.customerIntro: Who the agent is calling, and when.
simulator.outsideHours: A real call would be blocked at this time.
simulator.empty: Press Start call. The agent will speak first.
simulator.actionsIntro: Tool actions are simulated. Nothing is booked or saved for real.
simulator.prompt: What the AI is told (full prompt for this call)

leads.title: Leads
leads.intro: The people your agents may call. Every lead needs a source, and a consent record before it can be called.
leads.importIntro: Columns we understand: first_name, last_name (or one name column), title, gender, phone, email, source, consent. Other columns become per-call values, such as amount_due.
leads.fileHelp: Up to 2 MB. Columns for BVN, NIN, card numbers, PINs, OTPs or passwords are refused and never saved.
leads.defaultSource: Lead source for rows without one
leads.sourcePlaceholder: e.g. Website form, Lagos trade fair
leads.defaultConsent: These people agreed to be called (used when the file has no consent column).
leads.duplicates: {count} repeated phone numbers in the file were skipped.
leads.consentConfirm: This person agreed to be called, and we have a record of it.
leads.badPhone: That phone number is not valid.
leads.search: Search by name, phone or source
leads.empty: No leads yet. Import a CSV file or add one above.
leads.name: Name
leads.firstN: Showing the newest {count}. Use search to find others.
leads.dncIntro: Numbers here are never called by any campaign. People who say "stop calling" on a call are added automatically.
leads.dncAdded: Number added to the do-not-call list.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.intro: A campaign calls a group of leads with one agent, only within your calling hours.
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. Create one below.
campaigns.newIntro: Choose an agent, which leads to call and when.
campaigns.name: Campaign name
campaigns.windowHelp: Calls never happen before 08:00 or from 21:00 Lagos time, whatever you choose here.
campaigns.agentNotReady: The agent must be marked as ready before the campaign can call anyone.
campaigns.runIntro: Calls the next people who are due. Each one is checked against the compliance rules first.
campaigns.pretendHelp: Calls are pretend (mock phone line), so you can choose the time to see how calling hours work. With a real phone line, the real time is always used.
campaigns.batchFailed: {count} could not be called because of missing details for the lead.
campaigns.finished: Everyone in this campaign has been handled. The campaign is finished.

calls.title: Calls
calls.intro: Every call attempt, including the ones the compliance rules blocked, with the reason.
calls.empty: No calls yet. Start a campaign to see calls here.
calls.mockNote: This was a pretend call on the mock phone line: the customer's replies were generated.
calls.blockedBecause: This call was not made because:
calls.failedBecause: This call could not be made because:

billing.title: Billing
billing.intro: Calls are paid from a prepaid wallet in naira. Each answered call is charged per started minute; unanswered and blocked calls are free.
billing.mockNote: Payments are pretend for now: the checkout page does not take real money. Connect Paystack in the settings file to take real payments.
billing.covers: Enough for about {minutes} minutes of calls.
billing.low: Your balance is low. Campaigns stop when it cannot cover one more minute.
billing.rateHelp: Every started minute of an answered call.
billing.topUpIntro: Add money to your wallet. From ₦1,000 to ₦5,000,000.
billing.paid: Payment received. Your wallet has been topped up.
billing.mockCheckoutWarning: This is a pretend payment page for testing. No card is needed and no money moves.

credit.title: Credit
credit.paygHelp: Pay As You Go (PAYG): you add credit and only pay for the minutes you use
credit.askAdmin: Ask an owner or admin to add credit.

settings.title: Organisation settings
settings.name: Organisation name
settings.roleHelp: Owner: everything. Admin: manage members, billing, agents and settings. Editor: build agents, import leads and run campaigns. Viewer: read only.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.inviteHelp: They get an email link to join this workspace.
workspace.noPermission: Only owners and admins can invite members.
